top_signals.title: Is China Misreading the Moment?
top_signals.summary: When U.S. President Donald Trump lands in Shenzhen later this week for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit, he will sit down with Chinese leader Xi Jinping for the fourth time amid an unexpected détente between Washington and Beijing. The trade war of 2025 is in abeyance, the two governments have announced a relationship of “constructive strategic stability,” and, to the alarm of American allies, Trump and Xi are planning to meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin. Beneath the surface, however, the détente is beginning to crack.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Anthropic Leveraged ETF Race Heats Up Even Before Stock’s Debut
top_signals.summary: A slew of leveraged ETFs tied to SpaceX launched soon after its public debut, but only one managed to attract meaningful assets. That experience has raised the stakes for Anthropic: Issuers are racing to get out front in hopes that their fund becomes the one that captures the bulk of investor dollars.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: As UNIFIL winds down, Israeli presence in Lebanon complicates handover process
top_signals.summary: If the Lebanese authorities are unable to take physical possession of the positions, the handover could take place on paper only, sources said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
